claims.evidence: Origin and usage history cannot be determined from visual inspection of the exterior.
Witness confirmed PlayStation logo and PS4 text on the front edge.
Witness observed two grey wireless controllers.
The witness did not see the console powered on or the storage menu.

risks.risk: Internal storage (HDD) failure or smallest capacity (500GB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' section in the System Settings menu.
risks.if_unproven: as the minimum 500GB capacity with a failing drive.

risks.risk: Optical disc drive failure (cannot read physical games).
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: Console is banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: Controller analog stick drift or battery failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers navigating menus without ghost inputs.

risks.risk: Overheating due to dust or dried thermal paste.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a game for 10 minutes to check fan noise.

proof_requests: Video of the console booting up to the main dashboard.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing software version and storage.
Video of a disc being inserted and ejected.
Photos of the rear ports to check for damage or HDMI port wear.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity as a PS4 Darth Vader Limited Edition. It can be priced at the worst-case scenario for a non-tested unit of this specific model.
